title: React 19 Frontend Foundation, Tailwind ElevenLabs UI Kit, and API Client
acceptance_criteria: Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS initial project scaffold.
ElevenLabs-inspired monochrome UI component library: Button, Card, Badge, Input, Modal, MacroRing, ConflictResolutionModal, RateLimitBanner.
Type-safe HTTP API client with Axios or fetch wrapper.
Centralized error response interceptor implementing RFC 9457 reaction matrix (400, 403, 404, 409, 422, 429).
